sources.summary: An Israeli member of parliament advocated for the conquest, expulsion of Palestinians, and settlement expansion during a visit to the Gaza boundary. The remarks come amid ongoing tensions and international scrutiny over policies in Gaza.

sources.title: How Israel is weaponizing infectious diseases in Gaza
sources.summary: The article examines claims that conditions in Gaza have contributed to the spread of infectious diseases, framing them as a consequence of Israeli policies. It highlights deteriorating public health infrastructure and restricted access to medical resources.

sources.title: Israel seizes nearly 60 percent of Gaza as it plans to resume war, report says
sources.summary: A report states that Israel has taken control of a significant portion of Gaza territory while preparing for a potential resumption of military operations. The development raises concerns about the future of ceasefire efforts and regional stability.
